text:
I'm sorry to hear your monstera is struggling—that's frustrating. Yes, you can get help under our **30-day Plant Care Guarantee**.

Since your plant arrived 20 days ago and has lost more than a third of its leaves plus stem rot (which counts as significant decline), you're covered. Here's what to do:

1. **Claim within your guarantee window** (10 days left) from "My Orders"
2. **Upload at least two photos:** one of the whole plant and a close-up showing the stem rot
3. A Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days** and send you a free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock)

You don't need to send the plant back. Once you've submitted, you'll also get a new 30-day guarantee on the replacement.

If you'd like free care advice while you wait, our Plant Care Specialists are available by chat 9am–5pm Mon–Fri or by email at help@leafy.example.
